visual_goal: Show the six decisions of Part IX as one loop: sourcing, shared kernel, ownership, modernization and AI agents, closed by fitness functions that trigger a new sourcing review.
prompt: A loop illustration on a light background. Left: a balance between a hammer and a shopping cart labeled 'Sourcing'. One arrow right to a central hexagon core labeled 'Shared kernel'. From 'Shared kernel' two arrows: one up-right to a team of three generic figures labeled 'Ownership', and one down-right to a small robot holding a signed envelope labeled 'AI agents'. One arrow from 'Ownership' right to a crane lifting a block labeled 'Modernization'. Far right: a gauge with a needle labeled 'Fitness functions', with one arrow from 'Modernization' into it and one arrow from 'AI agents' into it. One long orange curved arrow along the bottom from 'Fitness functions' back to 'Sourcing', labeled 'review trigger'. These six labels plus the one arrow label are the only words in the image.
alt: Sourcing leads to a shared kernel, which feeds ownership and AI agents; ownership leads to modernization; modernization and AI agents feed fitness functions, which loop back to sourcing as a review trigger.
